items.old_memory: The number of concurrent Kestrel workers is set by `max_workers` (default 8). Lower it to reduce lock contention on the queue database; raise it for throughput when many short jobs are queued.

items.new_memory: Kestrel's `WorkerConfig` takes `poll_interval` (default 5 seconds), `lease_timeout` (default 60 seconds) and `max_workers` (maximum concurrent workers, default 8).
